wizard.title: Create Agency
wizard.description: Set up your agency with policies, team members, and partnerships

orgInfo.title: Organization Info
orgInfo.description: Choose a name and URL for your agency
orgInfo.slugHint: This will be your organization's unique identifier

dataPolicy.title: Data Ownership Policy
dataPolicy.description: Choose how data is handled when team members leave your agency

encryption.title: Encryption Policy
encryption.description: Choose the level of data protection for your agency
encryption.standardDescription: All sensitive data is encrypted at rest with your organization's dedicated key. Automatic and transparent — no action needed from your team.
encryption.enhancedDescription: Standard encryption plus an additional client-side encryption layer. Even server administrators cannot read protected fields.
encryption.pinRequired: Enhanced encryption requires a PIN. This PIN is personal and works across all your organizations.
encryption.pinExists: Your existing PIN will be used for this organization's encryption.
encryption.pinWarning: If you forget this PIN, your encrypted data cannot be recovered. Store it securely.

teammates.title: Add Teammates
teammates.description: Invite people to join your agency
teammates.connectionsDescription: Invite people from your personal network
teammates.emptyConnections: No personal connections to invite. You can invite teammates by email below.
teammates.duplicateEmail: This email has already been added

partnerships.title: Establish Partnerships
partnerships.description: Connect your new agency with agencies in your network
partnerships.emptyState: No agency connections yet. You can establish partnerships later from Settings → Network.

importData.title: Import Your Data
importData.description: Bring your existing properties, clients, and mandates into Oikion

features.csvExcel: Import from CSV or Excel spreadsheets
features.autoMapping: Automatic column mapping with smart detection
features.validation: Data validation with error preview before import

importData.yesImportHint: Go to the import wizard after creating your agency
importData.noImportHint: You can always import data later from the dashboard

polis.title: Oikion Polis — Matchmaking Network
polis.description: Choose how your agency participates in cross-agency property-client matching
polis.membershipDescription: How would you like to match with other agencies?

NONE.label: None
NONE.description: No cross-agency matching. You can enable this later.

POOL.label: Pool
POOL.description: Anonymous pool matching — your listings are matched against all participating agencies.

BILATERAL.label: Bilateral
BILATERAL.description: Match only with trusted partner agencies you explicitly connect with.

BOTH.label: Pool + Bilateral
BOTH.description: Participate in both the anonymous pool and bilateral partner matching.

polis.privacyDescription: How much information is shared when matches are found?

ANONYMIZED.label: Anonymized
ANONYMIZED.description: Only property/client specs are shared — no agency or agent details.

AGENCY_IDENTIFIED.label: Agency Identified
AGENCY_IDENTIFIED.description: Specs plus your agency name are visible to matching agencies.

FULL.label: Full Details
FULL.description: Specs, agency name, and agent contact info are shared with matches.

review.title: Review & Create
review.description: Review your agency setup before creating
review.partialSuccess: {sent} of {total} invitations sent. You can resend from Settings.
review.error: Failed to create organization. Please try again.
